title: Grimms Märchen
author: Jacob und Wilhelm Grimm
description: Three classic fairy tales retold in simple German: a girl, a wolf and a hunter; four old animals on their way to Bremen; and two children lost in the forest.
source: Kinder- und Hausmärchen (1812–1857), public domain. Retold for learners.

title: Verstand und Gefühl
author: Jane Austen
description: Two sisters, two kinds of love: sensible Elinor hides a broken heart, while passionate Marianne falls headlong for the charming Willoughby. An abridged retelling of Jane Austen's first novel.
source: Jane Austen, Sense and Sensibility (1811), public domain. Abridged and retold in German for learners.

title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
description: Clever, rich and sure of herself, Emma Woodhouse loves arranging other people's marriages, and gets almost everything wrong, including her own heart. An abridged retelling of Jane Austen's comedy.
source: Jane Austen, Emma (1815), public domain. Abridged and retold in German for learners.

title: Le Dernier Jour d’un condamné
titleEn: The Last Day of a Condemned Man
author: Victor Hugo
description: A young man sentenced to the guillotine writes down his last weeks: the prison, the other convicts, his hope of a pardon and a final visit from his little daughter. An abridged retelling of Victor Hugo’s short novel against the death penalty.
source: Victor Hugo, Le Dernier Jour d’un condamné (1829), public domain. Abridged and retold in French for learners.
